scope_limit: HOMS Curriculum is currently bounded to preparing and reviewing supplied curriculum requirements, learning outcomes, module or programme materials, assessment alignment evidence and declared gaps. It does not approve a curriculum, certify programme quality, determine accreditation, issue academic policy, or authorise institutional release.
review_pack_title: DIO HOMS Curriculum Controlled Evidence Review Pack
human_gate_reason: Curriculum approval, programme-quality conclusions, accreditation decisions, academic-policy decisions, institutional sign-off and final release remain with authorised academic and quality-assurance bodies.
